Panam and V arrange the ambush and recover the truck.

The recovered cargo is delivered to Boz before the Sunset Motel conversation.

quests.title: Lightning Breaks
quests.synopsis: Panam helps V attempt to ground the Kang Tao AV carrying Hellman. The operation causes communications failure before the crew knows the crash-site consequences.

The pair uses the power installation to produce the EMP.
The EMP is insufficient by itself; Panam uses a missile and the pursuit continues.

decisions.description: What the pair has actually done to the AV.

outcomes.description: Panam and V have brought down the AV. Crash-site deaths have not yet been discovered merely because this objective completed.

runtime.notes: No installed quest/scene condition has been verified. Require an observed branch/stage receipt; absence or zero alone cannot establish this outcome.

uncertainties: Mitch and Scorpion's decision to investigate is not a shared plan approved by Panam.
Do not announce Scorpion's death while the only known event is the distant crash.

V can help at the crash or leave Panam to handle it while pursuing Hellman.
Information from the pilot or physical tracks guides the chase.
Hellman is captured and Aldecaldo help arrives.
The medical interrogation is V's experience; do not broadcast its exact contents to absent nomads.

decisions.description: Who actually rescued Mitch and whether V stayed to help.

outcomes.description: V assisted Panam in freeing Mitch at the crash site.
V went directly after Hellman and Panam rescued Mitch without V; her response expresses resentment at being left.

runtime.notes: No installed quest/scene condition has been verified. Require an observed branch/stage receipt; absence or zero alone cannot establish this outcome.

decisions.description: Discovery of the crash-site casualties.

outcomes.description: Scorpion and fellow nomads died after approaching the armed AV; Mitch survived. This is discovered loss, not an intentionally caused murder by V.

runtime.notes: Need discovery/dialogue stage. Later family knowledge requires its camp disclosure, not solely V scanning a body.

decisions.description: How V learned where Hellman was taken.

outcomes.description: The pilot disclosed the destination during the encounter.

runtime.notes: Do not conflate pilot death, timing out, and receiving information. Their exact separate flags require scene extraction.

decisions.description: The objective and what each participant can know.

runtime.notes: No installed quest/scene condition has been verified. Require an observed branch/stage receipt; absence or zero alone cannot establish this outcome.

Mitch provides reconnaissance while Carol confronts the camp's shortages.
Reach Saul in Wraith captivity at the cement factory.
Get Saul out; stealth and an alerted escape provide different lived details.
The group shelters from the storm and argues about corporate dependence.
Completion, gratitude and private parting interaction follow the night.

decisions.description: The rescue plan has been shared with those at the briefing.

outcomes.description: Panam, Mitch and Carol know the proposed rescue and the camp's depleted condition.

runtime.notes: No installed quest/scene condition has been verified. Require an observed branch/stage receipt; absence or zero alone cannot establish this outcome.

decisions.description: Successful rescue versus an explicitly failed/abandoned attempt.

outcomes.description: Saul was freed and returned; V and Panam have earned a concrete debt of gratitude.

decisions.description: The route may affect the story they remember without changing rescue success.

The escape drew active pursuit; store only if that scene actually ran.

decisions.description: V's actual stance during the family-policy disagreement.

outcomes.description: V supported Panam's concern over dependence; this is a witnessed opinion, not a later romance flag.

runtime.notes: No installed quest/scene condition has been verified. Require an observed branch/stage receipt; absence or zero alone cannot establish this outcome.

quests.title: I'll Fly Away
quests.synopsis: Mitch invites V to a private farewell honoring Scorpion's wishes.

stages.description: Mitch offers the farewell; the availability window is not proof V accepted.
V follows Mitch to the chosen ravine location.
The pair sends Scorpion's car away as the farewell he requested.
Mitch thanks V and offers Scorpion's keepsakes.

outcomes.description: Mitch and V shared the ceremony and its personal significance.

Negotiation, combat or explicit departure each have different social consequences.
Carol and Cassidy react from their different priorities.
